程序包 org.bukkit

接口 RegionAccessor

所有超级接口:
FeatureFlagSetHolder, net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed, Keyed
所有已知子接口:
LimitedRegion, World
public interface RegionAccessor extends Keyed, FeatureFlagSetHolder
RegionAccessor 提供了获取、修改和生成 生物群系、方块状态 和 实体 的能力， 同时也支持生成一些基础结构。

原文： A RegionAccessor gives access to getting, modifying and spawning Biome, BlockState and Entity, as well as generating some basic structures.

    • getComputedBiome

      @NotNull @NotNull Biome getComputedBiome(int x, int y, int z)
      Gets the computed Biome at the given coordinates.

      The computed Biome is the Biome as seen by clients for rendering purposes and in the "F3" debug menu. This is computed by looking at the noise biome at this and surrounding quarts and applying complex math operations.

      Most other Biome-related methods named getBiome, setBiome, and similar operate on the "noise biome", which is stored per-quart, or in other words, 1 Biome per 4x4x4 block region. This is how Biomes are currently generated and stored on disk.

      参数:
      x - X-coordinate of the block
      y - Y-coordinate of the block
      z - Z-coordinate of the block
      返回:
      Biome at the given coordinates

    • generateTree

      boolean generateTree(@NotNull @NotNull Location location, @NotNull @NotNull java.util.Random random, @NotNull @NotNull TreeType type, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<? super BlockState> stateConsumer)
      在指定位置创建一棵树.

      提供的 consumer 会在因树木生成而改变的每个方块上调用。当 consumer 被调用时， 世界尚未被修改。这意味着在 consumer 中调用 getBlockState(Location) 会返回生成前方块的状态。

      在 consumer 中对 方块状态 的修改会被保留， 因此无需调用 BlockState.update().

      原文： Creates a tree at the given Location

      The provided consumer gets called for every block which gets changed as a result of the tree generation. When the consumer gets called no modifications to the world are done yet. Which means, that calling getBlockState(Location) in the consumer will return the state of the block before the generation.

      Modifications done to the BlockState in the consumer are respected, which means that it is not necessary to call BlockState.update()

      参数:
      location - 生成树的位置

      原文：Location to spawn the tree

      random - 用于生成树的随机数生成器

      原文：Random to use to generate the tree

      type - 要创建的树的类型

      原文：Type of the tree to create

      stateConsumer - 在每个被改变的方块上调用的 consumer

      原文：The consumer which should get called for every block which gets changed

      返回:
      如果树创建成功则返回true，否则返回false

      原文：true if the tree was created successfully, otherwise false

    • generateTree

      boolean generateTree(@NotNull @NotNull Location location, @NotNull @NotNull java.util.Random random, @NotNull @NotNull TreeType type, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.function.Predicate<? super BlockState> statePredicate)
      在指定位置创建一棵树.

      提供的 predicate 会在因树木生成而改变的每个方块上调用。当 predicate 被调用时， 世界尚未被修改。这意味着在 predicate 中调用 getBlockState(Location) 会返回生成前方块的状态。

      如果 predicate 返回 true，则该方块会被设置到世界中。 如果返回 false，则该方块不会被设置到世界中。

      原文： Creates a tree at the given Location

      The provided predicate gets called for every block which gets changed as a result of the tree generation. When the predicate gets called no modifications to the world are done yet. Which means, that calling getBlockState(Location) in the predicate will return the state of the block before the generation.

      If the predicate returns true the block gets set in the world. If it returns false the block won't get set in the world.

      参数:
      location - 生成树的位置

      原文：Location to spawn the tree

      random - 用于生成树的随机数生成器

      原文：Random to use to generate the tree

      type - 要创建的树的类型

      原文：Type of the tree to create

      statePredicate - 用于测试是否应设置方块的 predicate

      原文：The predicate which should get used to test if a block should be set or not.

      返回:
      如果树创建成功则返回true，否则返回false

      原文：true if the tree was created successfully, otherwise false

    • spawnEntity

      @NotNull @NotNull Entity spawnEntity(@NotNull @NotNull Location loc, @NotNull @NotNull EntityType type, boolean randomizeData)
      在指定位置创建一个新实体.

      原文： Creates a new entity at the given Location.

      参数:
      loc - 实体将被生成的位置

      原文：the location at which the entity will be spawned.

      type - 决定要生成的实体类型的实体类型

      原文：the entity type that determines the entity to spawn.

      randomizeData - 是否应在生成前随机化实体的数据。默认情况下，实体在生成前会根据其装备、年龄、 属性等进行随机化。随机化的例子包括羊的颜色、怪物装备上的随机附魔， 甚至僵尸成为骑鸡小僵尸。如果设置为false，实体在生成前不会被随机化， 这意味着它们的所有数据将保持默认状态，不会对实体进行进一步修改。 值得注意的是，只有继承 Mob 接口的实体 才提供生成随机化逻辑，因此此参数对其他类型的实体无效。

      原文：whether or not the entity's data should be randomised before spawning. By default entities are randomised before spawning in regards to their equipment, age, attributes, etc. An example of this randomization would be the color of a sheep, random enchantments on the equipment of mobs or even a zombie becoming a chicken jockey. If set to false, the entity will not be randomised before spawning, meaning all their data will remain in their default state and not further modifications to the entity will be made. Notably only entities that extend the Mob interface provide randomization logic for their spawn. This parameter is hence useless for any other type of entity.

      返回:
      生成的实体实例

      原文：the spawned entity instance.

      注意：创建的实体会保持对其创建时所在世界的引用， 应注意确保实体的生命周期不超过世界实例，否则会导致内存泄漏。

      原文： Creates an entity of a specific class at the given Location but does not spawn it in the world.

      Note: The created entity keeps a reference to the world it was created in, care should be taken that the entity does not outlive the world instance as this will lead to memory leaks.

      类型参数:
      T - 要创建的实体的类

      原文：the class of the Entity to create

      参数:
      location - 创建实体的位置

      原文：the Location to create the entity at

      clazz - 要生成的实体的类

      原文：the class of the Entity to spawn

      返回:
      创建的实体实例

      原文：an instance of the created Entity

      另请参阅:
      • addEntity(Entity)
      • Entity.createSnapshot()

    • spawn

      @NotNull <T extends Entity> T spawn(@NotNull @NotNull Location location, @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.Class<T> clazz, boolean randomizeData, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<? super T> function) throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
      在指定位置创建一个新实体.

      提供的函数会在实体被添加到世界之前运行。
      请注意，当函数运行时，实体实际上尚未进入世界。在此函数返回之前， 任何涉及传送实体等操作都是未定义的。 传入的函数在潜在的实体生成随机化之后运行，因此已经允许访问 mob 的值， 无论这些值是否已被随机化，例如属性或实体装备。

      原文： Creates a new entity at the given Location with the supplied function run before the entity is added to the world.
      Note that when the function is run, the entity will not be actually in the world. Any operation involving such as teleporting the entity is undefined until after this function returns. The passed function however is run after the potential entity's spawn randomization and hence already allows access to the values of the mob, whether or not those were randomized, such as attributes or the entity equipment.

      类型参数:
      T - 要生成的实体的泛型类型

      原文：the generic type of the entity that is being created.

      参数:
      location - 实体将被生成的位置

      原文：the location at which the entity will be spawned.

      clazz - 要生成的实体的类

      原文：the class of the Entity that is to be spawned.

      randomizeData - 是否应在生成前随机化实体的数据。默认情况下，实体在生成前会根据其装备、年龄、 属性等进行随机化。随机化的例子包括羊的颜色、怪物装备上的随机附魔， 甚至僵尸成为骑鸡小僵尸。如果设置为false，实体在生成前不会被随机化， 这意味着它们的所有数据将保持默认状态，不会对实体进行进一步修改。 值得注意的是，只有继承 Mob 接口的实体 才提供生成随机化逻辑，因此此参数对其他类型的实体无效。

      原文：whether or not the entity's data should be randomised before spawning. By default entities are randomised before spawning in regards to their equipment, age, attributes, etc. An example of this randomization would be the color of a sheep, random enchantments on the equipment of mobs or even a zombie becoming a chicken jockey. If set to false, the entity will not be randomised before spawning, meaning all their data will remain in their default state and not further modifications to the entity will be made. Notably only entities that extend the Mob interface provide randomization logic for their spawn. This parameter is hence useless for any other type of entity.

      function - 在实体生成前运行的函数

      原文：the function to be run before the entity is spawned.

      返回:
      生成的实体实例

      原文：the spawned entity instance.

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果 world 或 clazz 参数为空

      原文：if either the world or clazz parameter are null.
